descriptionChirho: Hanun (חָנוּן) — a proper name borne by (a) the son of Nahash, king of the Ammonites, who humiliated David's ambassadors (2 Sam 10:1-4; 1 Chr 19:2-6), and (b) two men who helped repair the wall of Jerusalem under Nehemiah (Neh 3:13,30). English 'Hanun/to Hanun/and Hanun,' Spanish 'Janún/a Janún/y Hanún,' Hindi हानून/और हानून, Arabic حانون/وحانون, Korean 하눈/하눌이, Swahili Hanuni/na Hanuni. The two clusters differ only by the conjunction waw prefix, not by referent.
